record.provider: Crust Network (free Web3Auth IPFS gateway + on-chain pinning)

free_tier.stated: Gateway writes are described as 'free' but need a signature; the storage quota itself comes from a Discord channel, not a published number: 'Get free storage quota: 1. Join Crust discord 2. Follow the pinned message on 📦free-storage channel'. Default storage order term is 6 months.

egress.terms: Free gateways list is published (github.com/crustio/ipfsscan lib/constans.ts, e.g. https://ipfs-gw.decloud.foundation). No bandwidth meter documented.

record.tooling: IPFS HTTP API-compatible authenticated gateway; also a standard IPFS Pinning Service endpoint usable cross-chain. rclone can read IPFS via the gateway; writes need the W3Auth signature flow.
record.chaining: Quota is granted per Discord/on-chain identity and the order is an on-chain transaction, so chaining means many funded Crust accounts. Closer to a staking scheme than a free tier.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: not stated. retention: 'The default storage time for a single transaction(order) is 6 months'; extension requires prepaying into a pool. request-rate: unknown. Signature gate is the practical binding constraint.
record.reliability_note: Write path is signature-gated; unauthenticated PUT returns 401 and reads of unknown CIDs return 403, so the gateway is not an open drop.

evidence.proved: 'Crust provides a web3-oriented gateway ... for free and 100% compatible with standard IPFS HTTP interfaces'; 'The default storage time for a single transaction(order) is 6 months'

record.notes: Gateway writes are described as 'free' but need a signature; the storage quota itself comes from a Discord channel, not a published number: 'Get free storage quota: 1. Join Crust discord 2. Follow the pinned message on 📦free-storage channel'. Default storage order term is 6 months.
